description: March 31, 2026Today, on International Transgender Day of Visibility (TDOV), we celebrate the lives, contributions, and resilience of transgender people everywhere—a day that, in its 17th year, is more essential than ever.Founded in 2009 by Rachel Crandall-Crocker as a joyful counterpoint to the somber Transgender Day of Remembrance (TDoR), TDOV honors our living community.
